content:
The **Southern Belle Motel** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

A small roadside motel serving travelers driving up the highway in what is now The Mire, it is the location of the Berkeley Springs Police Department's bomb disposal unit Boomer, who has been irreparably damaged and will liberally conscript passers-by to complete its original mission. [1] 

The motel is mostly a gutted ruin, with a single accessible room upstairs that is full of Toasters. Boomer is located on the ground near some picnic tables.

The Southern Belle Motel appears in *Fallout 76*.
